prompt: Our ginger kitten doesn't hide anymore; she grows (brave) and (brave).
explanation_ru: Для постепенного усиления признака с коротким прилагательным используется двойная сравнительная степень: braver and braver.

prompt: Doesn't the car-free square bring more and (shopper) to its wooden benches?
explanation_ru: Для нарастающего количества исчисляемых предметов используется конструкция more and more + существительное во множественном числе.

prompt: The (long) you cook sliced onions slowly, the (sweet) the cake tastes.
explanation_ru: Причинно-следственная связь «чем…, тем…» передаётся конструкцией the + сравнительная степень, the + сравнительная степень.

prompt: Since we cut back our tall front hedges, haven't we reported fewer and (theft)?
explanation_ru: С исчисляемыми существительными для постепенного уменьшения числа используется fewer and fewer + множественное число (fewer and fewer thefts).

prompt: My birthday cherry tree grows (wide) and (wide) over our sunny garden bench.
explanation_ru: Короткое прилагательное wide образует двойную сравнительную степень через -er: wider and wider.

prompt: Have you noticed our cafe's blueberry pies getting (small) and (small) while the menu boards grow?
explanation_ru: Глагол get с двойной сравнительной степенью smaller and smaller показывает постепенное уменьшение размера.

prompt: I love how Tereza's autumn reunion feels more and (relaxed), and everyone chats more and (openly).
explanation_ru: С длинными прилагательными и наречиями на -ly для нарастающего признака используется more and more + слово в начальной форме.

prompt: After Lucy's gentle morning stretches, retired neighbours walk uphill more and (easily).
explanation_ru: Наречие easily образует двойную сравнительную степень с повторением more: more and more easily.

prompt: Our Warsaw agency hasn't seen this before: more and (person) want home-based jobs, so offices need less and (space).
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым person берём множественное число (more and more people), а с неисчисляемым space — less and less space.

prompt: Aoi's guide says: the (carefully) you fold each corner, the (well) your paper bird keeps its shape.
explanation_ru: В конструкции the…, the… наречие carefully требует more carefully, а неправильное наречие well меняется на better.

prompt: Why do young bands forget that the (high) they turn studio volume, the (hard) it becomes to hear small rhythm mistakes?
explanation_ru: Обе части зависимости «чем выше…, тем труднее…» строятся по схеме the + сравнительная степень: the higher…, the harder…

prompt: Winter mornings in Oulu are freezing, so the school bus never waits. The (early) children pack their bags and gloves, the (calm) the walk feels. Parents also face fewer and (problem) before breakfast.
explanation_ru: Первые два пропуска образуют связку the earlier…, the calmer…; для уменьшения числа исчисляемых проблем нужно fewer and fewer problems.

prompt: I only went online to buy flour for a cake. Then I saw that free delivery started at fifty dollars, so I kept adding biscuits. The (many) snacks I put in my basket, the (much) money I spend! Why do my orders get more and (expensive) when I try to save?
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень и для many, и для much — more (the more snacks…, the more money…); с длинным expensive нужно more and more expensive.

prompt: Good archers never fight the bow. The (tightly) you hold the wooden handle, the (badly) your hand shakes before you shoot. Relax your fingers and breathe out slowly. With practice, your arrows fly (straight) and (straight) towards the yellow centre.
explanation_ru: В связке the…, the… tightly даёт more tightly, а неправильное наречие badly — worse; короткое наречие straight повторяется в форме straighter and straighter.

prompt: Sharing a student flat means our group chat pings all evening about dishes and lost keys. Yesterday I switched off notifications while writing my essay, and the difference surprised me. The (few) messages I check while studying, the (quickly) I finish each paragraph. Honestly, I waste less and (time) on silly jokes when the screen stays dark.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым messages в конструкции «чем меньше» нужно the fewer, с наречием quickly — the more quickly, а с неисчисляемым time — less and less time.

prompt: Andres: Did you really buy four clay mugs at the bus station? The (heavy) your backpack gets, the (slowly) we climb that steep footbridge! Nephew: Relax, Uncle, I can't go home without gifts. Andres: You say that on every trip, yet those stairs seem to grow (steep) and (steep)!
explanation_ru: В heavy конечная -y меняется на -ier (the heavier), наречие slowly даёт more slowly, а короткое steep образует двойную форму steeper and steeper.

prompt: Tama: I don't think reading past midnight helps before a morning law test. The (late) I stay up with my notes, the (little) I remember at nine o'clock. Cousin: Then stop drinking coffee after dinner and sleep early. Tama: Good idea, because my practice scores are getting (bad) and (bad).
explanation_ru: Конструкция «чем позже…, тем меньше…» требует the later…, the less…; неправильное прилагательное bad образует двойную форму worse and worse.

prompt: Don't rush when packing boxes: ___ you work, the more mistakes happen.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «чем…, тем…» перед сравнительной степенью обязателен артикль the, а fast не принимает more; частая ошибка — опускать the.

prompt: Put fresh hay in the cage often, so it smells ___.
explanation_ru: С коротким прилагательным clean обе части стоят в сравнительной степени через -er (cleaner and cleaner), без more.

prompt: Clear map boards stand at each bridge, so ___ get lost during evening runs.
explanation_ru: Joggers — исчисляемое существительное, поэтому нужно fewer and fewer; типичная ошибка русскоязычных — использовать less или не повторять fewer.

prompt: Book your beach hut early, because ___ you wait before the school break, the more you will pay for a quiet room.
explanation_ru: В парной конструкции the…, the… необходимо the longer; типичные ошибки — пропустить the или добавить лишнее more к короткому слову.

prompt: My spinach pies taste more and more good after chilling the dough.
answer: My spinach pies taste better and better after chilling the dough.
accepted_answers: My spinach pies taste better and better after chilling the dough.
explanation_ru: У good неправильная сравнительная степень better, поэтому нужно better and better, а не more and more good.

prompt: Never leave garage doors half open, because the darker the street gets, easier it is for thieves to spot bikes.
answer: Never leave garage doors half open, because the darker the street gets, the easier it is for thieves to spot bikes.
accepted_answers: Never leave garage doors half open, because the darker the street gets, the easier it is for thieves to spot bikes.
explanation_ru: Во второй части конструкции the…, the… нельзя опускать артикль the: правильно the darker…, the easier…

prompt: Aitor reminded his shy drama students that the more clearly they speak towards the back wall, the better the audience hears their jokes.
answer: Aitor reminded his shy drama students that the more clearly they speak towards the back wall, the better the audience hears their jokes.
accepted_answers: Aitor reminded his shy drama students that the more clearly they speak towards the back wall, the better the audience hears their jokes.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: обе части конструкции the more clearly…, the better… построены грамматически верно.

prompt: Wouter adds extra chocolate and banana to his hot crepe, and folding it gets harder each time. Which sentence fits?
options: The more filling he adds, the harder the crepe is to fold without drips.
The more filling he adds, the easier the crepe is to fold without drips.
The less filling he adds, the more the crepe drips onto his coat.
The filling gets more and more small while the crepe grows colder.
explanation_ru: Только первый вариант точно передаёт прямую зависимость из ситуации (чем больше начинки, тем труднее сложить) и верен по грамматике.

prompt: Facundo noticed that letting guests pick their own music early always improves the mood at his garden barbecues. Which sentence matches his experience?
options: The earlier guests choose the songs, the quieter the garden party becomes.
The more songs guests choose, the less people want to stay outside.
The sooner guests pick the playlist, the livelier the barbecue feels all evening.
The later the music starts, the more loudly everyone sings along from the start.
explanation_ru: Только третий вариант правильно отражает причинно-следственную связь: чем раньше гости выбирают музыку, тем оживлённее проходит вечер.

prompt: If you stretch slowly before swimming, your shoulders feel loose. → The more slowly you stretch before swimming, …
answer: The more slowly you stretch before swimming, the looser your shoulders feel.
accepted_answers: The more slowly you stretch before swimming, the looser your shoulders feel.
explanation_ru: Условное предложение с прямой зависимостью перестраивается в конструкцию the + сравнительная степень: the looser your shoulders feel.

prompt: Week by week in October, the morning mist stays even later over Lake Bled. → In October, the morning mist stays …
answer: In October, the morning mist stays later and later over Lake Bled.
accepted_answers: In October, the morning mist stays later and later over Lake Bled.
explanation_ru: Постепенное изменение от недели к неделе передаётся двойной сравнительной степенью короткого наречия late: later and later.
